assessment: This important work focuses on the impact of diet on age-dependent behavior decline, showing that worms grown on E. coli, a common laboratory diet, lose their thermotaxis ability as they grow older, and that a diet of LAB partially rescue this effect. The evidence supporting the claims is solid, although the mechanism for the effects is not yet fully characterized. The work will be of interest to scientists interested in aging, behavior, diet, and potentially the microbiome.
